boundary_functions.name: tf:stacks/pki:terraform_data.bootstrap_openbao_pki
boundary_functions.reason: No-op shim since ADR-032 — 3 downstream resources (cluster_secret_store, cluster_issuer_vault, cluster_issuer_cilium) serialize on a node whose real work runs asynchronously in a Flux/Helm Job.
boundary_functions.warning: Phantom gate: latent race absorbed only by cert-manager/ESO retries. Removal plan documented in secrets.tf:257-262 — execute it rather than adding new depends_on edges here.

boundary_functions.name: tf:stacks/storage:terraform_data.garage_buckets_keys

boundary_functions.warning: Do not split without replacing the namespace/adoption and secret handoff contract; preferred cut is routing the key through OpenBao + ESO.

boundary_functions.warning: Has no depends_on — the deploy chain is not gated on validate/test-tftest. Also the .upload-complete gate downstream is vacuous on rebuilds (stale flag never deleted). Fix both before optimizing the chain.
